name: Publish test
author: PointillViz maintainers
description: A temporary tool that checks automatic publishing. It will be removed.
long_description: Paints each cell by its total transcript count. It exists only to test that a pull request is checked, merged and released without a manual step, and is removed afterwards.

params.name: min_counts
params.label: Minimum counts
params.help: Cells with fewer transcripts than this are left unpainted.
